name: Get all behaviors and associated configuration
description: Get all behaviors and associated configuration Retrieves configured risk score behaviors that define how user actions affect their overall risk score. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/behaviors
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/behaviors
Retrieves configured risk score behaviors that define how user actions affect their overall risk score.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update configuration for risk behaviors
description: Update configuration for risk behaviors Updates risk score behavior configurations, defining weights and thresholds for risk calculation. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/behaviors
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/behaviors
Updates risk score behavior configurations, defining weights and thresholds for risk calculation.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; body (body) — Behaviors.

name: Clear the risk score for a particular user
description: Clear the risk score for a particular user Resets risk scores for specified users, clearing their accumulated risk history. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/{user_id}/reset
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/{user_id}/reset
Resets risk scores for specified users, clearing their accumulated risk history.
Required: account_id (path); user_id (path)

name: Get risk score info for all users in the account
description: Get risk score info for all users in the account Gets an aggregate summary of risk scores across the account, including distribution and trends. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/summary
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/summary
Gets an aggregate summary of risk scores across the account, including distribution and trends.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Get risk event/score information for a specific user
description: Get risk event/score information for a specific user Retrieves the detailed risk score breakdown for a specific user, including contributing factors. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/{user_id}

name: Create new risk score integration.
description: Create new risk score integration. Creates a new Zero Trust risk score integration, connecting external risk signals to Cloudflare's risk scoring system. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/integrations
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/integrations
Creates a new Zero Trust risk score integration, connecting external risk signals to Cloudflare's risk scoring system.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a risk score integration.
description: Delete a risk score integration. Removes a Zero Trust risk score integration, disconnecting the external risk signal source. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/integrations/{integration_id}

name: Get risk score integration by id.
description: Get risk score integration by id. Gets a Zero Trust risk score integration by ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/integrations/{integration_id}

name: Get risk score integration by reference id.
description: Get risk score integration by reference id. Retrieves a Zero Trust risk score integration using its external reference ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/integrations/reference_id/{reference_id}

name: List all risk score integrations for the account.
description: List all risk score integrations for the account. Lists all configured Zero Trust risk score integrations for the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/integrations
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/integrations
Lists all configured Zero Trust risk score integrations for the account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update a risk score integration.
description: Update a risk score integration. Overwrite the reference_id, tenant_url, and active values with the ones provided. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/zt_risk_scoring/integrations/{integration_id}
